text:
maria: FYI — planning to push the updated Dedicated GPU autoscaling policy (autoscale-policy v2) to pools 'dedicated-a' and 'dedicated-b' this Thu 02:00 UTC. Goal: tighten scale-down window and add minimum burst reserve. Will need a quick smoke and rollback plan.

sam: I can own the deploy if that works. I can be online 01:30-03:00 UTC for validation and rollback.

devon: Thanks — can you confirm the exact policy change? want to run a local dry-run against canary traffic.

maria: core diffs: reduce idle_threshold from 120s -> 45s, min_instances increased from 2 -> 4 for p95 lat spikes, add "burst_reserve": 1 per pool. snippet:
```json
{
  "name": "autoscale-policy-v2",
  "min_instances": 4,
  "idle_threshold_seconds": 45,
  "burst_reserve": 1,
  "scale_down_cooldown": 300
}
```

anya: Quick Q — does this change affect Dedicated Dedicated price or billing tags we track? we should tag the scale event so cost dashboards pick it up.

maria: tagging is in the rollout script (env: AUTOSCALE_TAG=dedicated-v2). Billing team pre-notified.

piotr: For smoke tests: can we run these steps? 1) route 5% canary traffic to dedicated-a, 2) run synthetic seq-length heavy job (20k tokens) for 10m, 3) check p95 latency, 4) confirm no OOMs in logs. I can prepare the job.

sam: plan sounds good. I'll also watch KV cache hit rates and CPU on the scheduler. If p95 > 2x baseline or any OOMs, immediate rollback.

infra-bot: Deploy scheduled: maria -> autoscale-policy-v2 to pools [dedicated-a,dedicated-b] at 2026-03-19T02:00:00Z. Reminder: use --dry-run first.

rachel: Small note — console dashboard "dedicated/pool-health" has a 5m retention view, but use the per-route tracing to confirm tail latency. Also make sure alert 'gpu-pool-down' is unmuted during the window.

maria: Rollback plan: run rollout script with --rollback flag which restores autoscale-policy v1 and drains newly created instances; expected rollback time 3-5m. Sam/Devon, confirm you have permission to execute rollback in the private console.

sam: I have permissions. I'll keep a host with SSH ready in case we need manual intervention.

devon: I'll run the dry-run in staging tonight and drop results here. If it looks flaky we delay by 24h.

anya: I'll update the weekly release note and post a short note in #general before the 02:00 UTC window.

maria: Thanks all. Post-deploy checks checklist for whoever runs it (copying here):
- run `./scripts/rollout-autoscale --policy autoscale-policy-v2 --pools dedicated-a,dedicated-b --dry-run`
- if dry-run OK, run without --dry-run
- send canary 5% traffic for 15m
- run synthetic job (piotr) and monitor p95, OOMs, error rates
- confirm no increase in token unit cost > 15% for 30m
- if issue -> `./scripts/rollout-autoscale --rollback --policy autoscale-policy-v1` and notify #incidents

piotr: I'll post the synthetic job results by 01:15 UTC. Good luck :thumbsup:

sam: Roger. I'll start the deploy at 02:00 UTC and ping when done.

maria: Closing loop — if anyone wants to pair on the smoke checks ping me before 01:00 UTC.
